algorithms.name: TS_hyb (Thompson Sampling with hybrid prior mu_hyb = P(pi* | pihat))

symbols.H_mech: residual entropy H(mu) - R_mech, R_mech = I(pi*; pihat)

conditions: there exists a prior mu over Pi (worst case over priors)
relies on Prop 4.1 of Shufaro et al. requiring D_KL(p_t || P^{pi*}) > c' > 0 (algorithm not yet concentrated)

source.label: thm:lb
source.quote: Consider the hybrid setting with $K$ policies and $N$ rounds. Under Assumptions \ref{ass:metric}--\ref{ass:h_llb}, there exist universal constants $c,N_0>0$ such that for any algorithm there exists a prior $\mu$ over $\Pi$ such that for all $N\geq N_0$: $\BR^*(N) \geq c\sqrt{\frac{KN\Hmech}{\log K}}$, where $\Hmech = H(\mu)-\Rmech \geq 0$.

results.notes: Paper's N is horizon T. Direct application of Shufaro et al. 2025 lower bound with H(mu) replaced by H_mech; proof assumes an extra KL non-concentration condition.

conditions: TS prior is the exact posterior of mu given pihat

source.label: thm:ub
source.quote: Let $\mu_{\mathrm{hyb}}$ be the posterior of $\mu$ after conditioning on $\pihat$. By construction, $I(\pistar;\pihat) = \Rmech$. Let $\mathrm{TS}_{\mathrm{hyb}}$ be Thompson Sampling with this prior. Then there exists a universal constant $C>0$ such that: $\BR_{\TShyb}(N) \leq C\sqrt{KN\,\Hmech}$

results.notes: Follows from Russo & Van Roy 2016 bound C sqrt(K N H(prior)) plus Jensen. Horizon dependence: TS does not need N, marked anytime.

symbols.H_mu: Shannon entropy of the prior mu of the optimal policy

source.label: thm:phase
source.quote: Let $s \geq 1$ be a target sample-complexity ratio. For $s > 1$ define the critical bias ... Then any model with $B_\mu \geq \Bcrit(s)$ suffers regret of at least $c\sqrt{KNH(\mu)/(s\log K)}$ for any $N \geq N_0$

results.notes: Corollary of Theorem 1 and Proposition 1 (mechanistic information channel bound).

symbols.eps_prior: prior mass off the recommended (wrong) arm
